mario.description: Complete 50-bar viola MIDI transcription, raised one octave. Written repeats follow the source export. Expressive MIDI tempo changes are replaced by a constant 150 BPM.

zelda.description: Complete 24-bar MIDI melody track, including the four-bar introduction and both main-theme sections. Source pitch and triplets retained. Separate harmony, bass and percussion tracks are omitted.

sonic.description: One complete 24-bar main-theme cycle, source beats 36–132: lead track 2 followed by the returning synth phrase on track 8 at beat 127. The separate introductory section and repeated second cycle are omitted; source pitch is retained.
